svg.title: Task execution: diff-first, and Done requires proof
svg.desc: Dragging a card to In Progress never writes silently: changes wait as a bounded diff until approved, then build + tests decide.
svg.text: Task execution: diff-first, and Done requires proof
Dragging a card to In Progress never writes silently: changes wait as a bounded diff until approved, then build + tests decide.
GENERATE · one file at a time
rest is stored as a pending diff
run build + test commands (real exit codes)
The card moves to Done · spec.md gets [x] · memory records the feature ·
The card stays In Progress · the reason is logged (dod-blocked, debt +15) · fix the
diff or run the failing command, then si aplicar again.
